# LPU Events

> Official student events discovery platform for Lovely Professional University (LPU), Phagwara, Punjab, India. Covers campus fests, hackathons, workshops, cultural events, student clubs, guest lectures, and academic conferences for 35,000+ students.

## Key Information

- University: Lovely Professional University (LPU)
- Location: GT Road, Phagwara, Punjab 144411, India
- Student Count: 35,000+
- Event Categories: Academics, Cultural, Innovation, Co-Curricular, Student Clubs, NSS, NCC, Fashion, Day Celebrations, Community Services

## Links

- [Live Events Feed](https://lpuevents.live/): Discover upcoming and ongoing campus events
- [Events Directory](https://lpuevents.live/directory): Full directory of all campus events
- [Academic Events](https://lpuevents.live/category/academics): Academic conferences, seminars, workshops, guest lectures
- [Cultural Events](https://lpuevents.live/category/cultural): Cultural fests, performances, music, dance, theatre
- [Innovation & Tech](https://lpuevents.live/category/innovation): Hackathons, project expos, tech workshops
- [Student Clubs](https://lpuevents.live/category/student-clubs): Technical, cultural, literary, and startup clubs
- [RSS Feed](https://lpuevents.live/feed.xml): Live RSS feed of upcoming campus events
- [About](https://lpuevents.live/about): About the LPU Events discovery platform
- [Contact](https://lpuevents.live/contact): Contact the LPU Events team
